findings.title: Deployed operator (023d819) misclassified Square subscription DELETE; corrected source is untested live
findings.counterexample: The actually-deployed operator (GIT_DEPLOYED_FILE@023d819, line 74) classifies delete-subscription success only on HTTP204 (`r.status===204?'DELETED':'DELETE_UNCONFIRMED'`). Square returned HTTP200, so the live run produced DELETE_UNCONFIRMED and the surrounding cleanup logic conservatively recorded SUBSCRIPTION_CLEANUP_UNKNOWN_NO_RETRY (subscription-cleanup.json). Current HEAD corrects this to accept HTTP200 with an absent/empty `errors` array as DELETED, verified only by re-reading the same cached Playwright response (operator-cached-response-readback.json, subscription-cleanup-readback.json) — no new Square request was made, and the corrected branch itself was never redeployed or exercised against a live Square response.
findings.impact: Cleanup-only, no business/payment/booking effect and no budget consumed twice (deleteRequests remained 1). Risk is limited to future reuse: if this corrected classification logic is reused for a genuinely ambiguous or erroring 200 response with a differently-shaped body, the fix's assumption about Square's exact DELETE contract is asserted by Codex without an independently citable authoritative source in this evidence bundle (unlike the F2 create-subscription citations in FINDING_DISPOSITION.md).
findings.test_coverage: tests/unit/r15-preview.test.ts adds three targeted cases (200+empty→DELETED, 200+errors array→DELETE_UNCONFIRMED, 200+malformed non-array errors→DELETE_UNCONFIRMED, and no-retry 409 on repeat) which correctly pin the new logic's boundaries, but none of them are executed against a real Square endpoint.
findings.minimum_safe_correction: Cite Square's official Webhook Subscriptions DELETE API reference for the exact success contract (as was done for CREATE in the prior review), and require one bounded live confirmation (or documented equivalent-endpoint precedent) before treating this classification as verified rather than provisional.
findings.required_proof: A single authoritative Square API reference for `DELETE /v2/webhooks/subscriptions/{id}` success semantics, or a fresh (budget-permitting) live delete-subscription dispatch confirming the corrected classification end-to-end.
